title: frqme's parkour
description: a dynamically generating parkour plugin like in your beloved servers
body:
🌟 FrqmesParkour: The Dynamic Jumping Challenge!
FrqmesParkour is a lightweight, fully automated Minecraft plugin that generates unique parkour courses on the fly! Whether you’re looking to practice your jumps, challenge your friends, or create a dynamic event, FrqmesParkour provides an endless stream of procedural jumping puzzles.

Crafted with dynamic generation in mind, it creates temporary paths between your defined points, pushing you to react and adapt with every leap. It’s perfect for server owners looking to add interactive minigames and players wanting to hone their parkour skills.

It's entirely self-contained, server-side, and designed to minimize performance impact.

✨ Features
⚡ Dynamic Course Generation: Never play the same course twice! The plugin randomly spawns blocks from a set pool, creating a procedural path between the Start and End points.

🛠️ Fully Configurable Material Pool:

Choose the blocks you want for the course! Use concrete, terracotta, glass, wool, and more!

Easily manage the block list in the config.yml.

🎮 In-Game Setup & Control:

Define the Start, End, and Teleport locations directly in-game.

Instantly reload the config without restarting the server.

Adjust the dynamic generation distance based on difficulty.

🔊 Immersive Feedback:

Listen to unique note block sounds with increasing pitch for every successful jump!

Enjoy a dramatic completion chime and teleport upon reaching the goal.

🧱 Temporary Blocks:

The plugin automatically places and removes blocks behind the player, keeping the world clean.

Smart management prevents the parkour from overwriting existing builds.

🛡️ Performance Optimized:

Highly optimized procedural algorithm ensures minimal impact on server TPS.

Handles block placement and removal efficiently.

⚙️ Configuration
You can configure FrqmesParkour in two ways:

💻 In-Game Commands:

/fpk start: Set the current block as the parkour's starting platform.

/fpk end: Set the current block as the target end platform.

/fpk point: Set your current location as the failure/success teleport point.

/fpk difficulty <EASY|MEDIUM|HARD>: Set the general difficulty (jumps per block).

/fpk reset: Stop all sessions and clear all set locations.

/fpk reload: Instantly reload the config.yml file.

📝 config.yml File:

You can manually tweak the settings and block pool in plugins/FrqmesParkour/config.yml:

YAML
blocks:
- WHITE_CONCRETE
- CYAN_CONCRETE
locations:
  start: # Automatically set via commands
  end:   # Automatically set via commands
  point: # Automatically set via commands
settings:
  difficulty: MEDIUM
📦 Dependencies
None! This is a self-contained, lightweight plugin.

🏆 Who is FrqmesParkour for?
Server Owners looking for a low-maintenance, high-engagement minigame.

Community Managers who want a fun, event-driven activity for players.

PvP Practice Servers focusing on agility and movement training.

Anyone who loves the thrill of an endless parkour challenge!
